technique_name: How can renewable energy reduce environmental pollution?
description: Renewable energy sources such as solar, wind and hydropower can help reduce environmental pollution as they do not produce the same toxic substances as traditional sources of energy, such as fossil fuels. These renewable energy sources produce little to no greenhouse gases, which are the main contributors to global warming and climate change.
